name: template
title: Zenith Template
description: AutoTemplate's routine as a Zenith file: start against the red wall holding 4 POLLEN, drive to the shooting spot, fire every ball. The poses are AutoTemplate's placeholders (TUNING_GUIDE step 9).

steps.notes: AutoTemplate's commands.driveTo(shootSpot, DRIVE_TIMEOUT_MS): a straight line from where the robot is, heading turned evenly (linear), given up after 4 s.

steps.name: shootAllWithRetry
steps.notes: AutoTemplate's commands.shootAllWithRetry(). It stops itself within 6.2 s (SHOOT_ALL_TIMEOUT_MS, one retry); the 7.5 s timeout is a backstop.
